AN ACT TO AMEND THE CEYLONESE BROTHERS: ST. JOSEPH  ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 301)
WHEREAS  the  Society  of  the  Ceylonese  Brothers  of
St.  Joseph  was  incorporated  by  the  Ceylonese  Brothers  of
St. Joseph Ordinance, No. 59 of 1942 :
AND WHEREAS the Society of the Ceylonese Brothers of
St. Joseph now wish to change its name to “Society of the
Sri Lankan Brothers of Charity” :
AND WHEREAS the said Society of the Ceylonese Brothers
of  St.  Joseph  has  now  applied  to  have  the  said  Ordinance
amended to give effect to such change in its name and it will
be expedient to grant such application :
BE it  therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Society of the  Ceylonese
Brothers of  St. Joseph (Amendment) Act, No. 4 of  2013.

2.
In every context in which the Society of the Ceylonese
Brothers of St. Joseph is mentioned (whether by that name or
by the abbreviation of the Ceylonese Brothers of St. Joseph
in the Ceylonese Brothers of St. Joseph Ordinance (Chapter
301),  other  than  in  the  long  title,  or  in  any  rule,  notice  or
other document made or issued under the Ceylonese Brothers
of St. Joseph Ordinance (Chapter 301), there shall, unless the
context otherwise requires, be substituted for the expression
“Society of the Ceylonese Brothers of St. Joseph” and for the
expression  “Ceylonese  Brothers  of  St.  Joseph”  the  words
“Society of the Sri Lankan Brothers of Charity” and the words
“Sri Lankan Brothers of Charity”.
